# LETS GO!

> Pick fun family walks together. Big buttons, bright colours!

A colourful, iPad-first family travel web app for picking walks together. Big touch targets, bright cards, short kid-friendly text.

## Pages

- [Home](https://letsgo.batleth.com/): big LETS GO! title, kid tagline, button to walks
- [Walks](https://letsgo.batleth.com/walks): grid of places with photo, name, CHOOSE toggle, and optional YouTube overlay
